summary: OpenAI and Broadcom jointly unveiled Jalapeño, OpenAI's first custom LLM-inference accelerator chip, designed for gigawatt-scale data center deployment starting in 2026 with Microsoft and other partners.

mechanisms.reason: The chip platform is explicitly tied to gigawatt-scale data center deployment with a major cloud partner.
mechanisms.quote: we are enabling the deployment of gigawatt scale data centers with Microsoft and other partners beginning in 2026.

mechanisms.reason: The platform incorporates Broadcom's Tomahawk networking silicon as part of scaling the compute system.
mechanisms.quote: Broadcom’s silicon implementation and networking technologies, including Tomahawk networking silicon, help bring the platform to large-scale production.

mechanisms.reason: The chip is claimed to substantially improve performance per watt versus current state-of-the-art inference hardware, reducing hardware content per token.
mechanisms.quote: early testing shows that Jalapeño will deliver performance per watt substantially better than current state-of-the-art.

categories.reason: The announcement is centered on a new custom AI accelerator chip co-developed by OpenAI and Broadcom.
categories.quote: an accelerator architected around OpenAI’s vision for the future of LLM inference

categories.reason: Broadcom's networking silicon is a stated component of the compute platform being industrialized.
categories.quote: Broadcom’s silicon implementation and networking technologies, including Tomahawk networking silicon, help bring the platform to large-scale production.

practices.reason: The performance-per-watt gain is achieved through first-party custom silicon and lab-internal infrastructure, not a technique an external team could apply to their own stack.
practices.quote: Early testing shows that the first-generation accelerator will deliver performance per watt substantially better than current state-of-the-art

notable_reason: A frontier AI lab unveiling its first custom inference chip with a named silicon partner and gigawatt-scale deployment plans is a significant infrastructure and custom-silicon signal for semiconductor investors.
